entries.title: Psalms 73:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> Truly God [is] good to Israel, To such as are pure in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 73:2
segments: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; My steps had nearly slipped.

entries.title: Psalms 73:3
segments: For I [was] envious of the boastful, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 73:4
segments: For [there are] no pangs in their death, But their strength [is] firm.

entries.title: Psalms 73:5
segments: They [are] not in trouble [as other] men, Nor are they plagued like [other] men.

entries.title: Psalms 73:6
segments: Therefore pride serves as their necklace; Violence covers them [like] a garment.

entries.title: Psalms 73:7
segments: Their eyes bulge with abundance; They have more than heart could wish.

entries.title: Psalms 73:8
segments: They scoff and speak wickedly [concerning] oppression; They speak loftily.

entries.title: Psalms 73:9
segments: They set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walks through the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 73:10
segments: Therefore his people return here, And waters of a full [cup] are drained by them.

entries.title: Psalms 73:11
segments: And they say, "How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?"

entries.title: Psalms 73:12
segments: Behold, these [are] the ungodly, Who are always at ease; They increase [in] riches.

entries.title: Psalms 73:13
segments: Surely I have cleansed my heart [in] vain, And washed my hands in innocence.

entries.title: Psalms 73:14
segments: For all day long I have been plagued, And chastened every morning.

entries.title: Psalms 73:15
segments: ¶If I had said, "I will speak thus," Behold, I would have been untrue to the generation of Your children.

entries.title: Psalms 73:16
segments: When I thought [how] to understand this, It [was] too painful for me-

entries.title: Psalms 73:17
segments: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; [Then] I understood their end.

entries.title: Psalms 73:18
segments: Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down to destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 73:19
segments: Oh, how they are [brought] to desolation, as in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.

entries.title: Psalms 73:20
segments: As a dream when [one] awakes, [So], Lord, when You awake, You shall despise their image.

entries.title: Psalms 73:21
segments: ¶Thus my heart was grieved, And I was vexed in my mind.

entries.title: Psalms 73:22
segments: I [was] so foolish and ignorant; I was [like] a beast before You.

entries.title: Psalms 73:23
segments: Nevertheless I [am] continually with You; You hold [me] by my right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 73:24
segments: You will guide me with Your counsel, And afterward receive me [to] glory.

entries.title: Psalms 73:25
segments: Whom have I in heaven [but You]? And [there is] none upon earth [that] I desire besides You.

entries.title: Psalms 73:26
segments: My flesh and my heart fail; [But] God [is] the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

entries.title: Psalms 73:27
segments: For indeed, those who are far from You shall perish; You have destroyed all those who desert You for harlotry.

entries.title: Psalms 73:28
segments: But [it is] good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, That I may declare all Your works.
